_comment: Tier-2 for sparta adaptive_grid and hypersonic_flow: the three 'not computed at compatible time' aborts, plus the fourth message that gets mistaken for them. Six decks differing by one or two lines were run on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial) against a 'fix fnp ave/grid all 1 50 50 c_npc[1]'. Verified verbatim: 'Fix for adapt not computed at compatible time (../adapt_grid.cpp:502)' when the adapt Nevery is 30 against Nfreq 50; 'Fix used in compute reduce not computed at compatible time (../compute_reduce.cpp:805)'; 'Stats and fix not computed at compatible times (../stats.cpp:203)'. TWO CORRECTIONS came out of running it. (1) Both entries said the failure is 'a mid-run abort right after the step-0 stats line, not a setup error'. Only the compute-reduce one is: it prints the step-0 row and then aborts. The adapt's own abort and the stats one both fire at SETUP with zero stats rows, so an agent told to look after the step-0 line would look in the wrong place for two of the three. (2) Both entries attached stats.cpp:203 to 'stats_style prints f_<ID> directly'. A PER-GRID fix printed that way gives 'Stats fix does not compute scalar (../stats.cpp:705)' instead — a shape complaint raised while the stats_style line is parsed, before any frequency comparison; :203 needs a fix producing a global scalar such as fix ave/time. Both entries were corrected in the same commit and this fixture produces all four messages. It also executes hypersonic_flow:4's actual point: the identical Nevery 30 driven by a per-grid COMPUTE (c_npc[1]) instead of the fix is accepted and runs rc=0. No measured number is pinned. COVERS: adaptive_grid:3, hypersonic_flow:4.
expect_in_output: adapt_nevery_not_a_multiple_of_the_fix_nfreq_message=ERROR: Fix for adapt not computed at compatible time (../adapt_grid.cpp:502)
compute_reduce_reads_the_fix_at_an_incompatible_time_message=ERROR: Fix used in compute reduce not computed at compatible time (../compute_reduce.cpp:805)
stats_prints_a_global_fix_at_an_incompatible_time_message=ERROR: Stats and fix not computed at compatible times (../stats.cpp:203)
stats_prints_a_per_grid_fix_message=ERROR: Stats fix does not compute scalar (../stats.cpp:705)
